verdicts.reason: The two leaderboards are nearly identical. In both, the headline has been pulled off its yellow block, so it no longer looks like the brand's design. Loose yellow bar fragments sit on top of the left photo. The 'ONLINE TRAINING BY' and 'FREYA ANOUK' labels are tiny, hard to read, and their black boxes don't line up with each other. The right-hand photo is a thin sliver squeezed between the yellow bars. A is slightly worse: its F-shaped yellow fragment cuts into the woman's arm and the TRX strap. B's two horizontal bars sit a little cleaner at the photo's edge.
